name: pending-state-rule-infallible-row-answer
body: `pending_state_present` takes an infallible per-table row answer (`FnMut(&str) -> bool`), so a database read error can only be folded to `true` by the caller's own closure — the fail-closed policy lives in `ArtifactDb::has_pending_state` and `db_has_pending_state`, not in the shared rule, and a read error is not distinguishable from a genuine dirty row by the rule itself. Upgrade to a fallible closure if the fail-closed policy ever needs to be centralised or the two predicates must report the read error apart from the verdict.
